title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
author: Anthropic
description: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
summary: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock.
takeaways: Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” The proposed offering will be made only by means of a prospectus.
Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders.
Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders.
